experiments.title: Downside beta — premium for covarying with the market on down days
experiments.hypothesis: Stocks that covary strongly with the market when the market declines earn higher subsequent returns (~6%/yr); downside beta estimated on down-market days over a trailing window, monthly formation/hold, long-only high-downside-beta tilt, controlling for ordinary beta, IVOL and coskewness.

literature_intake.source: Ang, Chen & Xing, Review of Financial Studies 19 (2006) 1191-1239 (NBER WP 11824)
literature_intake.finding: Harvest intake only; claim as published, not tested by us.
literature_intake.hypothesis_derived: Stocks that covary strongly with the market when the market declines earn higher subsequent returns (~6%/yr); downside beta estimated on down-market days over a trailing window, monthly formation/hold, long-only high-downside-beta tilt, controlling for ordinary beta, IVOL and coskewness.

limitations: Atilgan et al. (2020) find the premium does not survive value-weighting / fuller controls — carried in the intake as the live disagreement a frozen gate would settle.
Distinct from Harvest #4 aggregate-volatility beta and tail-risk beta; prereg must report overlap with those sorts and with Harvest #2 IVOL.

experiments.title: Post-earnings-announcement drift — SUE-sorted drift after earnings announcements
experiments.hypothesis: After a quarterly earnings announcement, prices drift in the direction of the seasonal-random-walk earnings surprise (SUE) for ~60 trading days; long-only top-SUE form, bottom-SUE as avoid only.

literature_intake.source: Bernard & Thomas, Journal of Accounting Research 27 Suppl. (1989) 1-36; JAE 13 (1990) 305-340
literature_intake.finding: Harvest intake only; claim as published, not tested by us.
literature_intake.hypothesis_derived: After a quarterly earnings announcement, prices drift in the direction of the seasonal-random-walk earnings surprise (SUE) for ~60 trading days; long-only top-SUE form, bottom-SUE as avoid only.

experiments.title: S&P 500 index inclusion — announcement-to-effective price pressure and its modern reversal
experiments.hypothesis: Announced S&P 500 additions move on index-fund demand between announcement (~5 trading days before effective) and inclusion, partly reversing within two weeks (classic form); modern 2016-2020 evidence finds the sign flipped — both forms must be frozen as separate pre-committed legs or the test does not run.

experiments.title: Dividend initiation drift — long-only post-initiation drift (omissions as avoid)
experiments.hypothesis: Firms initiating a cash dividend drift up ~+7.5% market-adjusted over the following 12 months (event month excluded); omissions drift down ~-11.0% and are used as an avoid/exit signal only, never a short.

literature_intake.source: Michaely, Thaler & Womack, Journal of Finance 50 (1995) 573-608
literature_intake.finding: Harvest intake only; claim as published, not tested by us.
literature_intake.hypothesis_derived: Firms initiating a cash dividend drift up ~+7.5% market-adjusted over the following 12 months (event month excluded); omissions drift down ~-11.0% and are used as an avoid/exit signal only, never a short.

experiments.title: Open-market repurchase announcement drift — value-stock form
experiments.hypothesis: Firms announcing open-market repurchases earn ~12.1% abnormal buy-and-hold return over the following four years; ~45.3% for high book-to-market announcers and ~zero for glamour announcers; a prereg freezing a 12-month window must state that as a deviation from the paper.

experiments.title: Book-to-market value premium — long-only high-B/M tilt
experiments.hypothesis: High book-to-market stocks earn higher average returns than low book-to-market stocks (HML); B/M formed annually with a conservative filing lag (fiscal years filed >=6 months before formation), held 12 months, long-only tilt judged at portfolio level.

literature_intake.source: Fama & French, Journal of Financial Economics 33 (1993) 3-56; Journal of Finance 47 (1992)
literature_intake.finding: Harvest intake only; claim as published, not tested by us.
literature_intake.hypothesis_derived: High book-to-market stocks earn higher average returns than low book-to-market stocks (HML); B/M formed annually with a conservative filing lag (fiscal years filed >=6 months before formation), held 12 months, long-only tilt judged at portfolio level.

experiments.title: Customer momentum — suppliers follow their principal customers (economic links)
experiments.hypothesis: A supplier's next-month return is predicted by its principal customer's prior-month return (>150 bps/month long-short alpha in the paper); long-only form = overweight suppliers whose customers just rose.

literature_intake.finding: Harvest intake only; claim as published, not tested by us.
literature_intake.hypothesis_derived: A supplier's next-month return is predicted by its principal customer's prior-month return (>150 bps/month long-short alpha in the paper); long-only form = overweight suppliers whose customers just rose.

experiments.title: Search attention — abnormal Google search volume (ASVI) price pressure
experiments.hypothesis: A spike in Google search volume for a ticker (ASVI vs trailing median) predicts price pressure over the next 1-2 weeks with reversal over the following year; weekly formation.
